title: Patch: one page-title treatment for every menu screen
thread:
**Issue #3223 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3223: Patch: one page-title treatment for every menu screen Opened by @squishy-squooby. ### What it does Menu screens title themselves in five different ways, at sizes from 17 px to 44 px: - **A.** A brand `h1` "JackiOh" plus an `h2` screen name inside `.panel--auth` (21 px, `auth/tavern.css:206`): shop, leaderboard, account, collection, ai, terms, privacy, copyright, purchases, accessibility, login, reset, invite, dungeon start. - **B.** A brand `h1` plus a `

` styled as a title (22 px): play (`play.tsx:684`), together (`TogetherRoute.tsx:175`). - **C.** The `h1` is the screen name, each in its own size and face: - stats: 26 px sans - workshop and Almanac: 21 px serif - patch notes: `clamp(28px, …, 40px)` - dungeon stats: `--type-2xl` - replays: the bare `index.css` `h1` - **D.** A visually hidden `h1` plus a `clamp(28–40px)` `h2`: practice (`practice.tsx:970,995`). - **E.** No `h1` at all: the dungeon RunScreen and the replay player. The decks route's loading shell says "JackiOh — decks" (`decks.tsx:80`); once loaded it says "Decks". One screen also mixes two heading styles. On `/practice` (seen in a browser at 1280x720), "Learn to play" is a small sans panel heading, and right under it "Practice against the AI" is a large serif display heading. Change: one `PageTitle` (the screen's `h1`, one face from `--font-display`, one step of `typescale.css`) placed in the top bar's title slot from #3218, or directly under the bar on a phone if the bar has no room. Use it on every menu screen. The brand appears in the logo, not as a second `h1`. One visible `h1` per page: no hidden `h1` with a visible `h2` doing its job, and no `

` styled as a title. Section headings inside a screen are `h2` in one shared style. On Practice, "Learn to play" and "Practice against the AI" become the same level and style. Keep the document `` per screen as it is today, unless it disagrees with the new heading. ### Acceptance - A test renders each menu route (at least the ones listed under A–E) and asserts exactly one visible `h1`, rendered by `PageTitle`. - No menu stylesheet sets a `font-size` on an `h1` other than the `PageTitle` stylesheet. - Practice's two section headings share one class. - The decks loading shell and the loaded workshop show the same title. - e2e specs `46` and `47` pass, since titles sit at the top that must stay put (R1581000). ### Blocked by, part of Blocked by #3218 ```
